_doc: Pieces of text the C++ glues together at runtime (MareLoc splits composed texts at sentences, line breaks and the HUD separators, and translates each piece). tools/ue58/i18n_extract.py always keeps these keys; the executable audit (-MareLocAudit, MARE_LOC_MISSING) and tools/ue58/loc_emulate.py find new ones. 09/11.
